{{Otheruses|Winter}}
'''Winter''' was one of four seasons in some [[Planet/Legends|planets']] [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

On the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Aiwha/Legends|Aiwha]] traveled south for the cold winters, as they would otherwise [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="TOTAP">{{StoryCite|story=The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|book=Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide}}</ref>
